en.headline: Centre for Food Safety finds malachite green in imported bluefin tuna sample
en.dek: The sample tested under the routine surveillance programme contained 1.74 parts per billion of the prohibited substance, and the importer has been notified.
body: The Centre for Food Safety announced on Thursday that a sample of imported bluefin tuna had tested positive for malachite green at a level of 1.74 parts per billion.

A spokesman said the sample was collected at the import level under the routine Food Surveillance Programme. The centre has informed the importer of the irregularity and is tracing the source and distribution of the product.

Malachite green is an industrial dye that has been used to treat infections in fish. It is prohibited in food sold in Hong Kong under the Harmful Substances in Food Regulations. Offenders are liable to a fine of $50,000 and six months’ imprisonment upon conviction. The investigation is continuing.

zh.headline: 食安中心在進口藍鰕吞拿魚樣本檢出孔雀石綠
zh.dek: 樣本含孔雀石綠1.74十億分率，中心已知會進口商並追查來源及分銷情況。
body: 食物安全中心周四公佈，一個進口藍鰕吞拿魚樣本檢出孔雀石綠，含量為1.74十億分率。
發言人表示，中心透過恆常食物監測計劃，從進口層面抽取樣本作檢測。中心已知會涉事進口商違規情況，並正追查產品的來源和分銷情況。
孔雀石綠是工業染料，曾被用於治理魚類疾病。根據《食物內有害物質規例》，所有在本港出售的食物均不得含有孔雀石綠。違例者一經定罪，可處罰款5萬元及監禁6個月。調查仍然繼續。
